collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The village wants to celebrate an elder's long life: hold the celebration, or ask the elder about the future.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is the oldest person in the village, and (friend) has organized a celebration of (subject.his/her) long life: songs, stories, everyone (subject.he/she) ever taught. (subject) says (subject.he/she) is tired of hearing about the past and would rather talk about what (subject.he/she) is going to do next. What should (friend) do?

text_only.reason: a celebration or a happy feeling in the story; no celebration happens in the game -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The celebration is held. (subject) listens to all the songs, then stands up and announces that next year (subject.he/she) is going to learn to swim. The village roars.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) turns the celebration into a planning night. (subject) has a long list: a new garden, a song to write, a quarrel to settle. The village helps with all of it.
